Thanks for telling me, Nadia. I've kept this between us. I haven't shared it with anyone, and I won't pass it on to Ruth or post it anywhere.

I also haven't taken any action on it. If you want Ruth briefed, the best route is for you to tell her yourself, since Mateo told you in confidence. I can draft a short note for you to send, or put a time on your calendar to talk with her. Tell me which you'd like.
